title: Hydrocarbon Release Risk Assessment
description: Free Hydrocarbon Release Risk Assessment template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers facility information, leak detection and monitoring systems, hydrocarbon inventory and isolation capabilities.

topics: Release Scenario Modeling And Consequence Analysis

Tier Definitions And Reporting (Api Rp 754)

TIER 1 - LOSS OF PRIMARY CONTAINMENT (LOPC) with greatest consequence:

☐ Release ≥ 1 metric ton (flammable/toxic)

☐ Fire/Explosion with ≥ $100K damage

☐ Evacuation/Community impact

☐ Fatality/Serious injury

TIER 2 - LOSS OF PRIMARY CONTAINMENT (LOPC) with significant consequence:

☐ Release ≥ 100 kg (flammable/toxic)

☐ Fire/Explosion with < $100K damage

☐ Shelter-in-place/Medical treatment

☐ Environmental impact

TIER 3 - CHALLENGES TO SAFETY SYSTEMS:

☐ PSV activation

☐ High-high alarm activation

☐ Near-miss LOPC

☐ Demand on safety system

TIER 4 - OPERATING DISCIPLINE / MANAGEMENT SYSTEM:

☐ Deviations from procedure

☐ Equipment failures (non-LOPC)

☐ Audit findings

☐ Training deficiencies
